get.description: List current user's friends (id, username, avatar_url, full_name).

schema.title: Response List Friends Api V1 Friends Get

get.description:
Return the main Friends app payload in a single API call.

Sets ``ETag`` (SHA-256 of the JSON body). With ``If-None-Match``, returns 304 and no body when unchanged.

ETag.description: Quoted SHA-256 of canonical JSON response body.

304.description: Not Modified — empty body; reuse the JSON from the last 200 for this URL.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Optional. Prior ETag value; server returns 304 when the JSON body is unchanged.
